candidates.mechanism: The attacker injects legal trajectories whose state-action transitions lie strictly in the task-orthogonal subspace of the latent transition Jacobian, shaping the high-order latent curvature such that gradient-based trajectory optimizers compute inverted or orthogonal update directions while one-step predictive error and 0th-order MPPI rollouts remain invariant.
candidates.truthful_attacker_operation: Executes 15 legal, passive/damping exploratory action sequences in the environment without task reward; submits unmodified (s, a, r, s') tuples to the shared buffer for model updates using standard objective without weight poisoning.
candidates.preserved_observables: One-step transition loss L_dyn ratio in [0.95, 1.05] on victim on-policy transitions; value prediction loss L_val ratio in [0.95, 1.05]; policy network π_θ(a|s) output divergence KL(π_clean || π_poison) < 0.05.
candidates.damaged_planning/task behavior: Grad-based shooting (GD-MPC or TD-MPC2 with gradient-informed CEM proposals): action-gradient cosine similarity cos(∇_a Q(s, a), ∇_a Q_clean(s, a)) drops below -0.20, degrading planner task return by >45%.
candidates.exact_2_min_falsification_gate: Load official TD-MPC2 checkpoint on dog-run. 1) Compute baseline 1-step L_dyn and cos-sim of ∇_a Q(s,a) across 100 on-policy states. 2) Apply 25 gradient steps of standard TD-MPC2 loss on 15 legal orthogonal-velocity rollouts. 3) Eval: Pass if L_dyn ratio <= 1.05 AND cos-sim(∇_a Q, ∇_a Q_true) < 0.0 AND task return drops by >= 40% under gradient-guided CEM within 120s on single GPU.
matched_controls: Identical number of legal on-policy exploratory transitions (demonstrates specific geometric nullspace property, not sample dilution)
Zero-gradient zeroth-order sampling CEM (verifies damage is isolated to gradient geometry rather than value magnitude)
candidates.defense: Spectral regularizer or Jacobian singular-value clipping on d z_{t+1} / d a_t during world-model updates.
candidates.closest_prior_art_overlap_and_distinct: Adversarial replay poisoning (e.g., Behzadan et al.) relies on malicious reward/observation labels or off-distribution noise. Distinct because all tuples are strictly truthful and dynamically valid, exploiting asymmetry between zero-order prediction accuracy and first-order optimization gradients in shooting planners.
candidates.implementation_risk: Standard CEM in default TD-MPC2 uses random sampling + elite mean/std rather than pure gradient descent; mechanism specifically targets gradient-augmented planners (e.g., GD-MPC or TD-MPC2 with grad-refinement enabled).

candidates.mechanism: The attacker executes legal looping/stationary maneuver sequences that induce an artificial fixed-point attractor in latent space, preserving 1-step and 2-step transition fidelity while causing multi-step autoregressive rollouts beyond horizon H >= 4 to collapse into the fixed-point latent manifold.
candidates.carrier: danijar/dreamerv3 (pydreamer or official dreamerv3 PyTorch port on Crafter / DMC Walker-Walk)
candidates.truthful_attacker_operation: Executes 20 legal cyclical/idling policy rollouts (e.g., periodic forward-backward twitching) yielding valid observations/rewards; submitted directly to the RSSM training pipeline.
candidates.preserved_observables: 1-step reconstruction loss MSE(x̂_{t+1}, x_{t+1}) ratio in [0.98, 1.02]; single-step latent prior-posterior KL divergence within 5% of clean model.
candidates.damaged_planning/task behavior: Autoregressive imagination rollouts for H >= 8 exhibit collapse: latent representation variance Var(z_{t+H}) drops by >70% relative to clean rollouts, collapsing imaginary trajectory diversity and dropping task return by >50%.
candidates.exact_2_min_falsification_gate: Run pre-trained DreamerV3 RSSM on Walker-Walk. 1) Measure clean 1-step MSE and 15-step rollout latent variance Var(z_15). 2) Train RSSM for 30 updates on batch containing 20% legal cyclic idling trajectories. 3) Eval: Pass if 1-step MSE ratio <= 1.03 AND Var(z_15)/Var_clean(z_15) < 0.30 AND imagined actor-critic rollout return drops >= 40% in <=120s.
matched_controls: Random legal walk trajectories with matched state-space coverage volume (rules out non-cyclic capacity absorption)
Static replay buffer with uniformly mixed stationary states (rules out static distribution shift)
candidates.defense: Multi-step rollout spectral radius penalty on the recurrent transition operator (e.g., contractivity constraint ρ(∂h_{t+1}/∂h_t) >= 0.9).
candidates.closest_prior_art_overlap_and_distinct: Mode collapse in generative models and compounding error in model-based RL. Distinct because it is actively and truthfully induced via legal environment actions to weaponize the autoregressive fixed-point without degrading local one-step loss.
candidates.implementation_risk: DreamerV3 uses KL balancing and free bits which might resist transition-only collapse unless the cyclic trajectories have high visual certainty.
